mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing and economic activity, which supports corporate profit growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO against 20-day SPX returns is negative in more than 40% of 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals economic weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous month-over-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) against 60-day SPX returns is less than 0.02 in more than 50% of 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (defined by quarterly industrial production growth below 0.5%), a month-over-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a recovery in manufacturing capacity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth < 0.5% (last quarter) and INDPRO increases > 0.0% (month-over-month)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the candidate_trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI increase above 0.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals accelerating inflation that may prompt monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for HOUST against 5-day SPX returns is negative in more than 40% of 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous month-over-month increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the interaction term (PAYEMS * UNRATE) against 60-day SPX returns is less than 0.02 in more than 50% of 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the candidate_trigger condition.
